name: Tickerbar
author: mryll
description: Multi-market price ticker (crypto, stocks, indices, commodities, forex, rates) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: market table. Middle click: refresh.

schema.label: Watchlist average on the bar
schema.description: Applies to the BAR only; the panel shows the average by default. follow = honor the config's summary_format; show forces it on the bar; hide removes it from both.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Where direction tinting is applied. Monochrome keeps the glyphs, the dimming and the signed change.
